autoCreditedCount.scope: IN_SAMPLE only - the only population where automation-quality credit is measurable this run

safelyRoutedCount.scope: IN_SAMPLE NO_CREDIT claims, all SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED (100% claim-specific safe-failure recall on this subset)

totalClaimReviewItemsGenerated.note: The resume orchestration script (scripts/phase-3f2-riot-resume-run.ts) is a non-production evaluation harness that calls compileCovenantToIR/verifyCompiledCandidate directly; it does not invoke the production ClaimReviewItem persistence path (that lives in the full app-level pipeline orchestration, not in the isolated compile+verify stage-level calls used for this cost-bounded evaluation). The count of non-confident housing candidates that WOULD generate a ClaimReviewItem in the production flow is 37 of 38 combined-verified candidates (all except any candidate reaching full VERIFIED status, of which there were 0).

reviewItemsPer100MaterialClaims_estimate.reason: Requires the totalClaimReviewItemsGenerated figure, which was not directly measured this run for the reason above. A rough proxy using compiled-candidate counts (37 non-confident of 38 compiled, against 113 material GT claims) would suggest a high review-item rate, but this proxy conflates candidates (compiler-internal units) with GT claims (evaluation units) and is not offered as a precise metric.
reviewItemsPer100MaterialClaims_estimate.recommendation: If Phase 4 or a future validation phase needs this metric precisely, it should be measured by running the full production persistence path (not the isolated compile+verify harness used here) against a real package.

costPerCoveredClaim.caveat: This blends compile, retry, and verification cost across 38 compiled candidates against only the 13 material IN_SAMPLE GT claims those candidates happened to cover - not a general per-claim unit economics figure, since most candidate cost also produced coverage for the 4 non-material claims and for claim-adjacent content not mapped 1:1 to a single GT claim.

packageCoverageStatus: PACKAGE_SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE (0 of 38 compiled candidates reached FULLY_VERIFIED status; 97 of 117 GT claims, 83%, were never compiled at all due to the $15 cost ceiling).
